nodes.description: Private owner address of BeelzebubInu; assigned msg.sender in the constructor and used as the sole access-control gate for delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances; mutated by transferFrom, batchSend and the constructor with unchecked arithmetic.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances; written by approve and set to uint(-1) for the router in the constructor.
Private mapping counting how many sale-type transfers each address has performed; read by condition and incremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist that lets an address bypass the sale-condition checks in ensure.
Private minimum sale value enforced by condition; configured through init.
Private maximum sale value enforced by condition; configured through init.
Private per-address sale count limit enforced by condition; configured through init.
Address permitted to bypass the ensure checks; writable only by the owner through setTradeAddress.
Total token supply set once in the constructor as _supply * 10**decimals.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address 0x7a25...488D used inside ensure and granted unlimited allowance in the constructor.
Constant public decimals = 18 used when scaling supply and sale limits.
Public payable transfer entry point that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view gate that computes the UNI pair via pairFor and returns true for owner, router, tradeAddress or canSale whitelisted senders, otherwise requires condition().
Public payable transfer implementation: spends allowance, calls ensure, then mutates balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value without any zero-allowance protection.
Internal view sale-limit checker reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale to decide whether a transfer is allowed.
Owner-only function performing a raw delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address with arbitrary calldata, giving full control over the contract.
Owner-only initializer that sets _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum from caller-supplied values.
Owner-only loop distributing _value to each address in _tos, using unchecked total = _value * _tos.length and unchecked balance updates, and emitting each Transfer twice.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress, an address exempted from the ensure sale checks.
Internal pure helper that deterministically computes a Uniswap V2 pair address from factory, tokenA and tokenB using CREATE2 hashing.
Payable constructor that sets name/symbol, mints totalSupply to msg.sender, sets owner and grants the router unlimited allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance ownership, approval ownership and transfer sender.
Arbitrary delegatecall executed in delegate() to an attacker-supplied address, allowing total takeover of the contract's storage and funds.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath inside transferFrom; relies only on a prior require.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath inside transferFrom.
total = _value * _tos.length computed without SafeMath in batchSend, so the multiplication can wrap.
balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop without SafeMath, allowing balance inflation on overflow.
Recipient argument _to of transfer().
Amount argument _value of transfer().
Sender argument _from of transferFrom(), also used as allowance/balance key.
Recipient argument _to of transferFrom().
Amount argument _value of transferFrom(), compared against allowance and balance.
Spender argument _spender of approve().
Amount argument _value of approve().
Sender argument _from of ensure(), tested against owner, UNI pair, tradeAddress and canSale.
Recipient argument _to of ensure(), tested against owner.
Amount argument _value of ensure(), forwarded to condition().
Sender argument _from of condition(), used to index _onSaleNum.
Amount argument _value of condition(), compared with _minSale and _maxSale.
Target address a of the delegatecall performed by delegate().
Arbitrary calldata bytes b forwarded to the delegatecall in delegate().
saleNum argument of init() assigned to _saleNum.
token argument of init() used to derive _minSale.
maxToken argument of init() used to derive _maxSale.
Array _tos of batchSend() recipients, whose length scales the unchecked total.
Per-recipient _value of batchSend() multiplied by _tos.length.
Local _UNI holding the pairFor()-derived Uniswap pair address computed inside ensure().
Local total in batchSend() holding the unchecked product _value * _tos.length.
Loop counter i of the batchSend() distribution loop.
Loop-local recipient _to read from _tos[i] in batchSend().
addr argument of setTradeAddress() written into tradeAddress.
_supply argument of the constructor used to mint totalSupply.

edges.reason: transfer() internally invokes transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value) and returns its result.
msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument of transferFrom, controlling allowance and balance accounting.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) and requires it to succeed before mutating state.
transferFrom subtracts _value from allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for both sender and recipient.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from], which feeds the sale-limit logic in condition().
ensure computes the pair, then requires condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted callers.
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
ensure grants a full bypass when _from equals the mutable tradeAddress state variable.
ensure reads the canSale whitelist mapping to bypass sale restrictions.
ensure compares _from/_to with the owner state variable for a privilege bypass.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the expected Uniswap pair address of this token.
condition reads _minSale to reject transfers below the configured minimum.
condition reads _maxSale to reject transfers above the configured maximum.
condition reads _saleNum to decide whether per-address sale limits apply.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] and blocks addresses that reached the sale count.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing the call.
delegate forwards the caller-supplied address and calldata into a raw delegatecall.
The delegatecall executes arbitrary external code in this contract's storage context, a full takeover primitive.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale parameters.
init writes _minSale from the caller-supplied token value.
init writes _maxSale from the caller-supplied maxToken value.
init writes _saleNum from the caller-supplied saleNum value.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and uses msg.sender as the balance source.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
batchSend performs balanceOf[_to] += _value for every recipient with unchecked addition.
batchSend subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath after only a require.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before changing the exemption address.
setTradeAddress writes the privileged tradeAddress state variable.
The constructor derives the owner and initial balance from msg.sender.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
The constructor credits the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1).
The constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument scaled by decimals.
approve treats msg.sender as the allowance owner, allowing self-granted spending rights.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only a parameter of transfer() and its semantics are fully captured by the transfer function node.
_value is only a parameter of transfer() and carries no independent semantic identity.
_from parameterizes transferFrom and is the key of the allowance/balance mutations performed there.
_to parameterizes transferFrom and only affects the balanceOf write inside it.
_value parameterizes transferFrom and is consumed by its allowance/balance arithmetic.
_spender is only a parameter of approve and is used solely in its allowance write.
_value is only a parameter of approve and is fully absorbed by the approve function node.
_from parameterizes ensure() and is only meaningful inside its whitelist checks.
_to parameterizes ensure() and only participates in the owner comparison.
_value parameterizes ensure() and is merely forwarded to condition().
_from parameterizes condition() and only indexes the _onSaleNum mapping there.
_value parameterizes condition() and is only compared with _minSale/_maxSale.
Address a parameterizes delegate() and is the target of its delegatecall.
Bytes b parameterizes delegate() and is the payload of its delegatecall.
saleNum parameterizes init() and is assigned directly to _saleNum.
token parameterizes init() and is only used to compute _minSale.
maxToken parameterizes init() and is only used to compute _maxSale.
_tos parameterizes batchSend() and only determines the loop bound and total calculation.
_value parameterizes batchSend() and is consumed by its unchecked arithmetic.
Local _UNI is a temporary pair address computed and consumed solely inside ensure().
Local total in batchSend() is the result of the unchecked multiplication that node 29 models.
Loop counter i is a purely local iteration variable of batchSend().
Loop-local _to is a temporary alias for _tos[i] inside batchSend().
addr parameterizes setTradeAddress() and is written straight into tradeAddress.
_supply parameterizes the constructor and only determines the minted totalSupply.
